development.what: the ARC-AGI-1 training split: the fixed vocabulary and these combinators were written against it; the invented words come from the solved programs of bench/verdicts/grid.json and the partials mined from the graded tasks themselves

heldOut.what: per task only: a word is never offered to the task it was mined or collapsed from, and the test outputs are never read before grading; the tasks themselves are training tasks

split.contaminated: the graded tasks are training-split tasks the vocabulary and the combinators were written against; only the words mined from a task are held out from it
